details: Democrats have secured control of both the House and Senate in the recent US midterm elections. This shift in power has immediately led to investor concerns about stricter regulation in the artificial intelligence sector, causing the Nasdaq Composite to experience a significant daily drop. The election outcome is also anticipated to curb further fiscal expansion and could ease upward pressure on US interest rates.
title: Democrats Win US Congress; Nasdaq Drops on AI Regulation Fears

details: The ongoing conflict involving Iran has intensified with reports indicating that tankers were struck in the Strait of Hormuz. These incidents occur amidst heightened fears of new US attacks in the region. Crude oil prices continue to remain above $100 a barrel, contributing to global inflationary pressures and increasing the likelihood of central banks considering further interest rate hikes.
title: Tankers Struck in Hormuz Amid US Attack Fears; Oil Prices Above $100

details: Russia has reported conducting overnight strikes on Ukrainian military-linked logistics terminals, critical energy infrastructure, and a dry cargo vessel in the Black Sea. These actions are aimed at disrupting Ukraine's military supply networks. The strikes come as discussions for renewed peace talks regarding the conflict continue.
title: Russia Claims Strikes on Ukraine's Energy and Logistics Infrastructure
